result.description: Product development and issue tracking system for teams and agents.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 (auth-code, Bearer access token) for multi-workspace apps; personal API keys (Authorization header, no Bearer prefix) that each user creates themselves.
result.access_detail: Gate audit (1): docs show no app review required for other workspaces to authorize an OAuth2 app; directory listing is optional marketing only. Absence-based, not explicit confirmation. Free-plan users cannot manage third-party apps, but can use personal API keys. Gate audit (2): API and webhook access included on all tiers incl. Free; no paid requirement.
result.api_notes: Single GraphQL endpoint https://api.linear.app/graphql with full introspection; queries and mutations cover issues, teams, projects, cycles, comments etc. Webhooks supported. Rate limits are standard on Free/Basic, 2x on the next tier, 5x on the top tier.

evidence.quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
Linear supports OAuth2 authentication, which is recommended if you’re building applications to integrate with Linear.
API and webhook access | Included | Included | Included | Included
You can also build your own integrations and submit them to the directory.
Linear's public API is built using GraphQL.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
Read-write access is provided through `https://mcp.linear.app/mcp` by default.
